- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant noted that fractional ownership allows investors to buy and sell smaller portions of an asset, increasing liquidity and lowering barriers to entry.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant mentioned that 24/7 trading allows investors to buy and sell assets at any time without intermediaries.
